lines.en: Half an inch off the ground, I drift.

lines.zh: 我移得很慢，光在身后拖。
lines.en: I move slowly, light trailing behind me.

lines.zh: 每一段路，我都留下回声。
lines.en: Every stretch of path leaves an echo of me.

lines.zh: 我绕着石壁飘，像一口气。
lines.en: I drift around the stone like a breath.

lines.zh: 我太小了，风能推着我走。
lines.en: I am so small the wind can push me.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草直起来了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass straightens up.
My shadow is faint as a watermark.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面飘，找受伤的。
lines.en: I skim the ground, searching for the wounded.
A faint chime with every step I take.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，不想惊动谁。
lines.en: I slip around stones, unwilling to startle anyone.
I drift to your side, then drift away.

lines.zh: 走过的地方会暖一点点。
lines.en: The places I pass grow a little warmer.
My body thins out inside the light.
I go slowly because I am listening.

lines.zh: 我穿过草丛，草叶合回去了。
lines.en: I pass through grass and the blades close again.

lines.zh: 我顺着石缝走，回声更深。
lines.en: I follow the crack in stone; the echo deepens.

lines.zh: 我停了，光还在一明一暗。
lines.en: I stop, and my light keeps pulsing.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的回声，很小。
lines.en: I hear my own echo; it is very small.

lines.zh: 我在数这附近有几处伤口。
lines.en: I am counting the wounds nearby.

lines.zh: 我裹紧自己，像收起的伞。
lines.en: I fold in on myself like a closed umbrella.
A little cold; I turn my glow brighter.
I hum a melody that has no lyrics.

lines.zh: 这里安静，我就能听见血。
lines.en: It is quiet here; I can hear blood moving.

lines.zh: 我等一会儿，也许有人需要我。
lines.en: I wait a while; someone may need me.

lines.zh: 我对着水面照了照自己。
lines.en: I look at myself in the water.
My light is not enough to show the path.
There is a faint taste of iron in the air.

lines.zh: 我把多余的光收进胸口。
lines.en: I tuck the extra light into my chest.
My echo returns, and I smile.

lines.zh: 我在等一个擦破膝盖的人。
lines.en: I am waiting for someone with a scraped knee.

lines.zh: 有人在这儿咳了一声，我听见。
lines.en: Someone coughed here; I heard it.

lines.zh: 我的光暗下去，又亮起来。
lines.en: My light dims, then comes back.
You look down and meet my glow.

lines.zh: 我在看你的手，那里破了。
lines.en: I am looking at your hand; it is cut.
A fleck of my light is in your eyes.
I do not blink; I only glow.
Do not flinch; I do not bite.

lines.zh: 我看你很久，你有点累了。
lines.en: I watch you long; you seem tired.
I have remembered the sound of your breathing.

lines.zh: 你抬眼看我，光晃了一下。
lines.en: You glance up and my light flickers.
My glow finds the tear at your cuff.
You lean close, so I float back a little.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的伤口，不盯脸。
lines.en: I stare at your wound, not at your face.
When you smile, my light brightens too.
I scatter a bit, then gather again.
I feel no pain; I only grow fainter.
You knocked my light apart.
Do not slash; I cannot heal myself.
I glow again, and it costs me much.
That blow left me missing a corner.
My hand passes through your sword.
It is others who hurt, not me.
My echo skipped a single beat.

lines.zh: 你把我打远了，我还会回来。
lines.en: You knock me far, and I will still return.
I do not eat; I only give off light.

lines.zh: 你的面包很香，可惜我没嘴。
lines.en: Your bread smells good, but I have no mouth.
You want to feed me; I would rather heal you.
Flowers, yes; bring them a little closer.

lines.zh: 我舔不到，可我能闻到甜。
lines.en: I cannot lick it, but I can smell the sweetness.

lines.zh: 把食物收好，留着路上吃。
lines.en: Keep the food; save it for the road.
One breath of flowers is enough for me.

lines.zh: 这支光束不是吃的，别塞。
lines.en: This beam is not food; do not push it at me.

lines.zh: 你饿的时候，我帮不了胃。
lines.en: When you are hungry, I cannot help your stomach.

lines.zh: 蜂蜜太黏，会粘住我的光。
lines.en: Honey is sticky; it would cling to my light.
I approach it only to take a look.
You keep the food; give me the wounds.
I really do not need it, but thank you.

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，我会绕着走。
lines.en: Set the food down; I will float around it.

lines.zh: 糖放在石头上，我只闻一闻。
lines.en: Leave the sweet on the stone; I only sniff.
If you are hungry, eat first; I am in no hurry.
You passed through me; it tingles.
I bump into you and my light scatters.
Touch me and I scatter; do not push.
I go around you, afraid I am too cold.

lines.zh: 我们碰在一起，像两口气。
lines.en: We touch like two breaths meeting.
Your shoulder knocks me crooked.
One brief touch is all; do not worry.
You step where I was; only air remains.
Let me pass; I am heading over there.

lines.zh: 碰到的瞬间，你的疼轻了。
lines.en: At the touch, your pain eased a little.
I am too small to look for a partner.

lines.zh: 两只回声相撞，会亮一下。
lines.en: Two echoes meeting flare once, brightly.
May I trail behind you for a while?
I will share half my light with you.

lines.zh: 一个人走太静，回声也空。
lines.en: Walking alone is quiet; even echoes feel empty.

lines.zh: 我们不用说话，亮一下就行。
lines.en: We need no words; one flicker is enough.
I drift along, hugging your shadow.

lines.zh: 回声会散，我想先记住你。
lines.en: Echoes fade; I want to remember you first.
Do not walk me far; I will not want to leave.

lines.zh: 等你也变成回声，我们再聊。
lines.en: When you become an echo too, we will talk.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根掉落的羽毛。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen feather.
This cloth could wrap a wound.
I nudge a potion bottle to your feet.
I hold it up; my light shines through.
I gather the fallen seeds into my light.
This flower can still be saved.
I cannot lift it, only push.
You dropped this; here it is.

lines.zh: 会反光的，我都想收起来。
lines.en: Anything glinting, I feel compelled to gather.
Everything I find goes into your pocket.

lines.zh: 我不是要打你，我是要治你。
lines.en: I am not here to fight; I am here to mend.
The one bleeding; I will go there first.
Something about the way you walk is wrong.
I smell a wound running hot.
Let me come close, just once.
Your knee is trembling.

lines.zh: 有个人在墙后喘得很重。
lines.en: Someone behind the wall is breathing hard.
Found it; the smell of blood.
Do not fear; I am no predator.
I float toward you, very slowly.
I circle you, ring after ring of light.
You dodge; I will wait a moment.
The wound is on the left shoulder; I see it.
I do not chase; I simply follow.
Your hand presses your side; it hurts there.
Almost there; hold still.
My light is getting closer and closer.

lines.zh: 你喘一下，我就靠近一寸。
lines.en: Each breath you take, I inch closer.

lines.zh: 我绕开你的剑，不想被削。
lines.en: I avoid your sword; I do not want to be cut.
After this one, there is another.
My touch is a healing, not a blow.
Do not swing; I will not strike back.
That touch closed half the wound.

lines.zh: 我撞进你怀里，把疼带走。
lines.en: I bump into your chest and take the pain.
You hit me, and still I heal you.
I touch your arm; it is burning hot.
Light seeps into the wound and tickles.
I press a little harder; bear with me.
The bleeding stopped; breathe out now.

lines.zh: 我不擅长打架，只擅长这个。
lines.en: I am not good at fighting, only at this.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋裂开，我飘了出来。
lines.en: The spawn egg cracks and I float out.
A small knot of light lands by your feet.

lines.zh: 刚出生，我的回声还很轻。
lines.en: Just born, my echo is still very light.

lines.zh: 我一出现，附近的疼就少了。
lines.en: The moment I appear, nearby pain lessens.
I am small; I can only mend small hurts.

lines.zh: 从光里掉下来，摔得不疼。
lines.en: I fall out of the light without any pain.
Hello; I am the newest one.

lines.zh: 蛋壳还在，我的光就亮了。
lines.en: Shell fragments remain and already I glow.

lines.zh: 我把第一束光给了最近的你。
lines.en: I gave my first light to the nearest one: you.
I am another new echo, just begun.
At a touch of flame, my shape shudders.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，散成几点。
lines.en: I fall from high and scatter into flecks.
Underwater, my light sinks very slowly.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹成一圈涟漪。
lines.en: The blast blows me into a ring of ripples.
The arrow passes through and takes only light.
Magic makes my glow painfully bright.
I do not starve; I only dim.

lines.zh: 雷声太大，我的回声响了。
lines.en: Thunder is loud; my echo rings on.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我的光没有回声。
lines.en: In the void, my light has no echo.
